label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.page: Accessibility statement page of the shop
findings.problem: The first page is a long accessibility statement with about 30 links before any shop navigation; Skip to main content does not move focus into the content, so I had to tab through every link to reach the shop menu.

findings.page: Accessibility statement page of the shop
findings.problem: After declining cookies, the shop menu appeared as a list item named MEN that took focus first, then a second MEN link; pressing Enter on the list item did nothing visible, so the same item felt like a dead stop.
Skip to main content link did not skip anything; the next Tab went to the Men link in the header, so it gave no shortcut to the product area.
About 20 side menu links (Boots, All Styles, Lace-Up and so on to Accessories) must be tabbed through one by one before reaching the page content, with no way to jump past them.

Product tiles (names and prices such as the featured styles) are shown on the page but Tab skips them completely: after the FILTERS button focus went straight to SHOP ACCESSORIES and then SHOP SHOE CARE. No product, SHOP ALL link, or add-to-cart could be reached by keyboard, so I could not start the purchase.
